functions.name: applyColors
functions.description: Push the full explicit colour map to every open folder pane and (re)install the observers needed to keep rows coloured correctly as the user scrolls, switches tabs, or opens new windows.

parameters.name: colors
parameters.description: Map of "accountId path" -> "#rrggbb", as produced by shared.js folderKey().

functions.name: clear
functions.description: Remove all injected styling and observers from every open window (used on disable/uninstall shutdown).
